_comment: Finding-level adjudication of run-2 on mt-test-studio @ 36972b38 — the first scan with the
list(queryset) round-trip fix and the semantic no-op rule in place.
SAME STANDARD as run-1 and run-4: is the inefficiency real, AND would the proposed code run
in the direction claimed. adjudicated:false — one model pass, pending human confirmation.
ONLY ONE VERDICT TRANSFERRED FROM RUN-1. Matching run-1 and run-2 findings by file, line and
proposal text, exactly one of forty was byte-identical. The SITES are stable — recall @ high
is 100% and candidate coverage 100% in both runs — but the authored PROPOSALS are almost
entirely rewritten between runs at temperature 0 with three-sample triage. Detection and
triage are reproducible; authoring is not, and no number in this file should be read as
reproducible to better than the spread across runs.
adjudicatedBy: one model pass; pending human confirmation
